top_signals.summary:
Nine countries now possess nuclear weapons. Arms control agreements painstakingly built over decades have collapsed. Geopolitical competition is intensifying rivalries between nuclear-armed powers. North Korea continues expanding its arsenal and delivery systems. China is on a trajectory to go from roughly 600 warheads today to around 1,500 by 2035. top_signals.title: Heatwave Slams Europe Straining Energy Supply, E.On CEO Says
top_signals.summary:
As Europe is hit by its fifth heatwave, the continent's largest energy provider joins Bloomberg's Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie on 'The Opening Trade'. "We see massive increases in wholesale prices because of the Persian Gulf. We've seen extremely high gas prices putting stress on customers and affordability. Right now we see a very hot summer curtailing output that will lead to short-term distortions. We need to continue but it's stressful."
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Commission accelerates IRIS² deployment with enhanced security and expanded satellites network
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 07 Aug 2026 Today, the European Commission and the SpaceRISE consortium concluded negotiations and signed an implementation agreement to roll out IRIS², the European Union's new flagship satellite constellation. The agreement, among other things, adds 66 satellites into low Earth orbit to the programme, bringing the main constellation to 348 satellites, and moving it from planning to full-scale deployment.
